issue.title: [system-i18n 01/05] Add stable database keys and nullable system names (#235)

body:
Relay BB run pushed an update.

Pull request: #354

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Pushed branch `bb/relay-235-system-i18n-01-05-add-stable-database-thr_49gc7rz8cw` to origin.

## Summary

Implements issue #235 ([system-i18n 01/05] Add stable database keys and nullable system names):

- New migration `0027_database_keys_nullable_names.sql` adds a unique English camelCase `databases.key` column (mirroring `properties.key`), drops the `NOT NULL` constraint on `databases.name` and `properties.name`, and backfills `key`/nulls `name` for the ten hardcoded system databases (issue #24) on installs provisioned before this migration existed. Idempotent and additive per the expand/contract migration discipline.
- `databasesStore.createDatabase` / `propertiesStore.createProperty` now require `name` only for non-system rows (application-level validation, not a DB constraint), and convert a duplicate `key` into a `ConflictError`.
- `seedTenDatabases.ts` seeds the ten hardcoded databases and their built-in properties with a null `name` and their module id as `key`; view labels now source from the module-registry manifest instead of the now-nullable `database.name`.
- `permissionManifest.ts` (the one in-repo consumer needing a display string) falls back to the raw `key` — not a translation — when `name` is null, per the issue's explicit scope until #147 wires a real i18n resolver.
- New test file `databaseKeysNullableNames.test.ts` covers validation, duplicate-key rejection, the fresh-seed shape, and the pre-#235-schema migration upgrade path (including idempotency). `smoke.test.ts` updated for the new null-name reality.

All checks pass: full monorepo build, lint, format check, dependency-boundary check, and the complete test suite (114 unit + 716 integration + 5 e2e tests, 100% green).

Pushed commit `d1daa1c` to branch `bb/relay-235-system-i18n-01-05-add-stable-database-thr_49gc7rz8cw` (existing branch tied to PR #354, no new branch created).

This push addresses the AI code review feedback on PR #354:
- **HIGH**: scoped the `0028_database_keys_nullable_names.sql` backfill's property-name nulling to only the built-in keys `seedTenDatabasesInTransaction` itself creates per database, so properties added by later module seeds (e.g. `seedEmailModule.ts`'s `People.emails`) are no longer wiped on an upgrade install.
- **MEDIUM**: `databasesStore.ts`'s `createDatabase` now rejects a `key` on a non-system database.
- Added regression tests for both fixes.

Verified this turn: full build, lint, `check:boundaries`, migration-numbering check, format check, and all three test tiers (unit 114/114, integration 767/767, e2e 5/5) pass.

This push fixes the HIGH-severity finding from the latest code review: the migration's `builtin_keys` allowlist for the `companies` database was missing `"projects"` — the key created by the `companies → projects` relate() call — which would have left that property's old English name un-nulled on an upgrade install while a fresh install always nulls it. Added a regression assertion covering `companies.projects` to the backfill test.

Verified this turn: full build, lint, format check, `check:boundaries`, migration-numbering check, and all three test tiers (unit 114/114, integration 767/767, e2e 5/5) pass.

Added a regression test.
